title: USGS National Water Information System: gauge names and station numbers
note: Gauges listed on each river Overview. U.S. government data. Station numbers for Rogue, Salt, Ruby-Horsethief, Westwater, Green (Greendale), White Bird, Middle Fork Lodge and Selway were not re-checked against USGS from this build; confirm before publishing.

title: Terrain elevations and gradients (AWS Terrain Tiles from USGS 3DEP)
note: Put-in and take-out elevation and gradient measured along each river centerline by scripts/geo/elevation.mjs, rounded to 50 ft. Accurate to a few tens of feet; Black Canyon was set by hand because the dam wall distorts the terrain data there.

title: Geology, natural history and history summaries (USGS, NPS, BLM, USFS and state agency pages)
note: Rock sequences, fish and wildlife lists and history entries added for all rivers. Written as original summaries from general knowledge and agency and encyclopedia pages; species lists are regional, not surveys. Check before store submission.

title: Indigenous history entries for the added rivers
note: Short summaries naming the peoples whose homelands the rivers cross. Written from general sources, not tribal ones. Have them reviewed by, or attributed to, the relevant tribes before publishing.

title: National Hydrography Dataset and Watershed Boundary Dataset (USGS National Map)
note: Streams, reservoirs and lakes, drainage areas and the basin outlines behind each river's Basin map. U.S. government data. Dam names come from the project's own list (scripts/basin/dams.json), not from this dataset.

title: USGS Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) and National Hydrography Dataset main stems
note: The Topo map's river line for every river except the Grand Canyon is the NHD main stem along the trip's run. The guide's river miles are pinned to it at rapids, falls, bars and creek mouths whose names match a GNIS feature on the line (scripts/basin/centerline.py). Rivers with no such matches (Black Canyon, Rio Chama, Dolores, Flaming Gorge, Westwater, Ruby-Horsethief) use the put-in, take-out and trip length alone. U.S. government data. Sun and shade use USGS 3DEP elevation (AWS Terrain Tiles), as for the Grand Canyon.
